findings.reason: a worker handed "name the live attempt at all three sites" will either invent an attempt at a site whose condition is that none is known live, or silently leave the site out, and the plan does not say which it wants.
findings.text: `s6` lists `reckon/crew/resumption.py` near line 1112 among the "three sites" of the live-process refusal and asks the composed message to name "the live attempt", but that site is `_stream_in_motion_refusal`, which refuses only when `reading != "liveness unknown"` fails and the newest stream is still in motion — the reading that fires there says no process is known live, so an attempt named from `attempt-<n>-worker.json` would be the stale attempt the run just failed to observe ending; the plan's own rule ("A detail the records do not hold is left out, never guessed") is the only thing stopping the node from contradicting the refusal it is composing
